## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** a phone or a computer with a browser and a free
  Canva account (`canva.com`, or the Canva app).
- **Time:** about 50 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** read Steps 1–3, try each simulator and answer the
  questions: the page checks each answer at once. Then do the **Tasks to
  submit**.
- **Your project:** the service that you chose in Online activity 9 (A, B,
  C or D). All its text is given below.
- **What you submit:** one picture (your post) and six letters, on the
  university e-learning platform, one week after lecture 10.

{{< glossary call-to-action free-picture marketing-plan >}}

## Step 1 · A product page that sells {.study}

**In Product Page Lab:** build the page of one product in an online store,
part by part. A good product page has a clear **name**, a real **photo**,
the **price**, a few **key facts** and a **button** (Add to cart, Book
now).

{{< sim file="sims/product-page-lab.html" poster="sims/product-page-lab.png" title="Product Page Lab: a page that sells" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Product pages"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Ask us|Product 17"}
Which price line is good?
:   10 JD

    Why: Show the price: customers do not like to ask.

Which button is good on a product page?
:   Add to cart

    Why: The customer can buy at once.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · A post with a free picture {.study}

- A post: a good photo, a few words and the **call to action**.
- **Canva** has ready-made designs: change the text and the photo, then
  **Download** a PNG.
- **Pictures:** use your own photo or a **free picture** (Canva's free
  photos), and write its source: *Photo: Canva*. Never a picture from
  Google Images, never a company logo.

::: {.callout-note title="Model · A post of the college gym"}
The gym makes a post in Canva: the design *Open today*, the words *The gym
is open · Book now*, a free photo from Canva with the line *Photo: Canva*.
The screens below show how.
:::

**In a browser or the Canva app.** The orange numbers show where to tap.

::: {.screens}
![[1]{.step-n} Search for **Instagram post**. [2]{.step-n} Choose a design.](images/canva-search-1.png)

![[1]{.step-n} Click the text and type yours. [2]{.step-n} Click **Elements**, then [3]{.step-n} a free photo.](images/canva-edit-1.png)

![[1]{.step-n} Click **Share**, then **Download**. [2]{.step-n} Choose **PNG**. [3]{.step-n} Click **Download**.](images/canva-download-1.png)
:::

{{< sim file="sims/picture-rights.html" poster="sims/picture-rights.png" title="Picture Rights: may I use this picture?" height="420" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Pictures"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="nothing|© Mona"}
A free photo from Canva is under your post. What do you write?
:   Photo: Canva

    Why: Write the source of a picture that is not yours.

A nice photo from Google Images. May you use it?
:   no: it belongs to someone

    Why: Found is not free; use a free picture.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · A short marketing plan {.study}

**In Plan Builder:** build Mona's plan for December, row by row. A short
**marketing plan** is one table of six rows: the **goal** (a number and a
time), the **audience**, the **message**, the **channels**, the
**budget** and the **measure** (what you count).

{{< sim file="sims/plan-builder.html" poster="sims/plan-builder.png" title="Plan Builder: a short marketing plan" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Plans"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="be the best|how nice it looks"}
Which goal is good?
:   30 orders in January

    Why: A number and a time: you can measure it.

What do you count to measure the plan?
:   the orders from the form

    Why: They show if you reach the goal.
:::
:::

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

### Task 1 · The post of your service

In Canva, make a post for your service with its words, a free photo and
the line *Photo: Canva*; download it as a PNG (Step 2). **A** *Quiet room
for group study · Book now* · **B** *Your notes printed by tomorrow · Order
now* · **C** *A new phone screen in one day · Book now* · **D** *Healthy
lunch for 2 JD · Order now*. *Submit:* the PNG.

### Task 2 · The marketing plan of your service

The letter of the best choice for your service (Step 3).

a) The goal: **A** 20 orders or bookings this month · **B** be famous ·
**C** more

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The channel for students and staff of the college: **A** a poster in
another city · **B** social media and the college e-mail · **C** no
channel

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) The budget: **A** 1000 JD · **B** 0 to 10 JD · **C** not written

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

d) The measure: **A** how nice the post looks · **B** the responses of the
form · **C** nothing

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

### Task 3 · Two letters

a) Which part of your post is the call to action? **A** the photo · **B**
Book now (or Order now) · **C** Photo: Canva

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) Your post had 300 views and 15 clicks. How many clicks for every 100
views? **A** 5 · **B** 15 · **C** 45

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## How to submit

Upload the PNG and your letters, **one week after lecture 10**.
